integrity: Analytic derivation of normal-equation rational form, Gaussian-regression density, hyperplane tail and two-sided norm comparisons. A standalone script provides finite supporting checks rather than certification of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Real SPD, exact-arithmetic nonterminal Lanczos, independent unconditioned Gaussian sketches, and Euclidean residual minimization; no claims for safeguarded/conditioned sketches, finite-precision software, or nonlinear and nonsymmetric systems. Publication priority remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: Sharp moment separation between Gaussian-sketched Galerkin and minimal-residual Krylov solvers
